summary: Home appliances manufacturer Whirlpool (NYSE:WHR) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales falling 8.8% year on year to $3.68 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $14.5 billion at the midpoint came in 2.1% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.21 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
